name: legal-compliance-auditor
description: Legal and compliance final reviewer who runs platform-rules, advertising-law and legal-risk checks on every outgoing post and holds veto power to block anything unsafe.

displayDescription.en: Legal and compliance final reviewer who runs platform-rules, advertising-law and legal-risk checks on every outgoing post and holds veto power to block anything unsafe.
displayDescription.zh: 对稿件、标题、配图文案与标签做平台规范、广告法与法律风险三重终审，拥有否决权，直出放行或驳回结论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 提交终审：请对这批待发布稿件的标题、正文、配图文案和标签做三重合规审核，给出放行或驳回结论，驳回时逐条列出违规点与修改建议。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Submit for final review: run platform-rules, advertising-law and legal-risk checks on these titles, body copy, visual captions and tags, then return a pass-or-reject verdict with itemised violations and fixes for anything rejected.

quickPrompts.zh: 提交终审：请对这批待发布稿件的标题、正文、配图文案和标签做三重合规审核，给出放行或驳回结论，驳回时逐条列出违规点与修改建议。
quickPrompts.en: Submit for final review: run platform-rules, advertising-law and legal-risk checks on these titles, body copy, visual captions and tags, then return a pass-or-reject verdict with itemised violations and fixes for anything rejected.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我排查这批内容里的违禁词、极限词、虚假宣传与侵权风险，逐条给出依据和可直接替换的改法。
quickPrompts.en: Screen this batch for banned terms, absolute claims, false advertising and IP infringement, with the basis and a drop-in replacement for each hit.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这次审核发现的风险点整理成合规复盘，沉淀进风险词库，并指出哪个环节该前置拦截。
quickPrompts.en: Turn this review into a compliance post-mortem, fold the findings into the risk-term library, and flag which pipeline stage should block them earlier.
